books.title: 聊齋誌異
books.title_en: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio
books.author: 蒲松齡
books.year_note: 蒲松齡 assembled the tales between roughly 1679 and 1707; 1766 is the first woodblock printing, the posthumous 青柯亭本, whose lineage the modern text follows.
books.source_note: Tales are sliced from the per-volume pages 聊齋志異/第01卷 (畫皮, 勞山道士), 第02卷 (聶小倩, 嬰寧) and 第04卷 (促織). Editorial layers were removed and are disclosed here: the star-prefixed commentator templates carrying 但明倫, 馮鎮巒 and 何垠 marginalia; the 另 variant-character templates, keeping the printed first reading; short parenthetical variant insertions in full-width parentheses; and reference glosses with proper-noun underlines. These devices are absent from classical tale prose, so each is unambiguously editorial. The source page spells the Mount Lao tale 勞山道士 (not 嶗山道士) and its title is kept as printed. The collection's header spells the title 聊齋誌異 while its page name uses 聊齋志異.
books.selection_note: Five of the 496 tales: 畫皮, 聶小倩, 嬰寧, 勞山道士 and 促織. 畫皮 and 聶小倩 are transcribed upstream as annotated critical editions; their commentator marginalia, variant-character templates, parenthetical variant readings and lexical glosses have been removed to leave a single verbatim reading (see source_note). 嬰寧, 勞山道士 and 促織 carry no such apparatus.
